data.exact_reserve_text: The claims incurred, as stated within the financial statements of GBP 7.2m (2014: GBP 5.5m) includes a deterioration of GBP 2.2m on 2013 & Prior years and a marginal movement on the other years of account (2014: GBP 0.3m deterioration) in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end principally due to the adverse developments of legacy European creditor reserves.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development on legacy European creditor business
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development primarily on legacy European creditor and Group business contributing to a deterioration on 2013 & prior years

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 14.697m. The syndicate recorded prior-year adverse development of approximately GBP 2.2m (strengthening of reserves) primarily driven by adverse developments on the legacy European creditor and Group business and by lengthening reporting patterns which required increased IBNR. This represents roughly a 15% strengthening versus opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 2.2m on 2013 & Prior years
adverse developments of legacy European creditor reserves
lengthening of reporting timing by claimants
worse than expected development primarily on legacy European creditor and Group business
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development: narrative states a GBP 2.2m deterioration on 2013 & prior years (used as gross PYD). The gross claims development triangle shows current estimates for older years that imply minimal movement; there is a discrepancy between the triangle and narrative. The narrative figure was used because it explicitly attributes the deterioration to legacy European creditor business. Triangle may be affected by RITC and FX movements; numbers in triangle are presented in GBP '000. Confidence downgraded accordingly.
